lines: It was told to stand there. It stood.
Incoming! That is the city shooting at us!
She is holed. I have to pull her off.
C'mon, just get us over the roof. Once.
The chains were cold and they went on forever.
Below us, Bevelle had already started ringing its bells.
I remember thinking we were going to be in time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Thousand years under the sea, and she still flies, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: She flies 'cause we fixed her. You're welcome!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Everything they owned is behind us.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: ...Yeah. Behind us.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: YUNA! Bevelle! They are marrying her to that man!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: It's in Bevelle. And it's within the hour!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Bevelle. Fine. Everybody hold on to something

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Nobody asked me twice. Nobody is going to have to.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: She is in there alone.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: I am flying! Be quiet and be impressed!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Okay. Weapons, plan, go. What've we got?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Six of us. No summoner

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: Nobody on this deck can heal anything.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: I've got potions! Lots of potions. That's... kinda it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Then ration them.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Whoa. Somebody built that on purpose, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Too white. Nothing lives there

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Hey! Something just came off the city!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: It isn't scrambling.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: It was already up here. Waiting for us.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Bevelle keeps a dog on the step.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Hmph. Mind the teeth.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Listen up! I can move this ship, or I can shoot!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Not both. You pick, and you pick fast!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Pops! Just keep us in the air!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Missiles away! Count them, they are not free!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: It's faster. Why's it faster?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: It quit guarding, ya? Now it's hunting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Its throat! Watch its throat, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Get out of its reach! Now!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Distance did that, ya? Not you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: It just... dropped.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: It was told to stand there. It stood.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That's it? We just won?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: No.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Incoming! That is the city shooting at us!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: She is holed. I have to pull her off.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Wait, we're not going in?!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Cid
dboxTimeline.text: Not like this.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: C'mon, just get us over the roof. Once.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: You'd be alone down there.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Yeah.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Hey. Brudda.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: ...Go get her.
The chains were cold and they went on forever.
Below us, Bevelle had already started ringing its bells.
I remember thinking we were going to be in time.
